package.description: Merge duplicate contacts and vCards into one clean address book, on your own computer.

en-US.description: Merge duplicate contacts and vCards into one clean address book, on your own computer.
en-US.longDescription: ContactAttic is a local-only desktop app that merges vCard and VCF files, exports and old address-book backups into one clean, de-duplicated set of contacts, each person only once. Nothing is ever uploaded.
en-US.name: ContactAttic
